criteria.requirement: Reproduce the memory fault and verify the supplied interaction on production browser and Windows.
Store evaluated values, preserve exactness and certified irrational precision, and preserve absolute/relative percentage semantics.
Cover all memory functions, magnitudes, negatives, chains, context, language, continued precision and async invalidation.
Run native Rust and independent CLI/WASM combinatorial oracle checks, including percentages, powers, roots and intervals.
Prove worker deadline, native termination, bounded recovery, cancellation and stale-response rejection.
Measure actual Windows working sets, private commit, shared pages, auxiliaries, estimated increment, CPU in multiple phases and startup.
criteria.limits: System-level deltas reflect the machine during the run. Startup types indicate fresh/reused profiles. Recovery is a finite observation.

criteria.requirement: Re-run native Windows app and browser, UI, themes, seven locales, offline, responsiveness and accessibility.
Exceed 95% Rust core coverage and supplement it with browser behavior and independent calculations.
Verify security, lockfiles and Windows, macOS and Linux CI with appropriate build/runtime claims.
Publish reviewed 0.1.1 correction and evidence, preserve historical baseline and avoid a stable release.
criteria.limits: Published development source and audit evidence. Objective 01 requires independent review and explicit approval.

criteria.requirement: Start in navy Dark on fresh profiles regardless of system scheme and retain saved choices.
Keep the project bilingual, the future increment target recorded and Objective 02 unstarted.
